integrity.proof_basis: Fourier/radial spectral decomposition and exact per-eigenspace probe ranks.
integrity.reproducibility: checker.py requires Python 3 standard library; checker_output.txt records finite checks.
integrity.scope: The equality is analytical for every real positive coupling, with finite arithmetic checks as corroboration.

scientific_limitations: Finite homogeneous adjacency single-excitation wheels; one hub and at least five rim sites.
Every spoke is the same real positive strength; losses are at exactly two vertices.
The asymptotic capture law does not give a finite-time convergence rate and is not robust to exact resonance detuning.
Broader historical priority beyond inspected accessible materials awaits independent assessment.
title: Resonant loss of coherent capture in spoke-weighted quantum wheels
